topic: Infection risk with biologics: TB, HBV reactivation, PJP prophylaxis thresholds

source.title: Systematic literature review informing the 2022 EULAR recommendations for screening and prophylaxis of chronic and opportunistic infections in adults with autoimmune inflammatory rheumatic diseases
source.whyItFits: Open systematic review behind the 2022 EULAR infection-screening recommendations. It states the IGRA versus TST comparison, HBsAg reactivation risk, anti-HBc monitoring, and a prednisolone threshold at which Pneumocystis prophylaxis should be considered.
